newsitem.title: USA: DC Intertie power flows trimmed slightly Thursday.
newsitem.headline: DC Intertie power flows trimmed slightly Thursday.

text.p: Converter maintenance on Thursday will slightly reduce capacity on the DC segment of the Pacific Intertie, said the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), which operates the Northwest portion of the system.
Southbound transmissions on the 2,000 megawatt line will be cut to 1,956 megawatts (MW), while northbound flows will be limited to 1,904 MW Thursday from 0800 to 1500 PST, BPA said.

Meanwhile, maintenance Monday and Tuesday on the 3,200 MW AC segment of the line will reduce southbound flows to 2,800 MW and northbound transmissions to 2,500 MW between 0800 and 1700 PST on both days.
